Who TF is Buying Homes in Texas Right Now?!
The Texas housing market in 2025 is full of noise — headlines scream “crash” and “collapse,” prices are falling in some areas, and inventory is high. But homes are still selling, builders are still building, and investors are still buying. So who’s actually buying houses in Texas right now?

In this video, we break down:

✅ Why 30,000 homes were still sold in Texas last month
✅ The difference between owning vs. affording a home
✅ Why a house is a liability until it becomes an asset
✅ The rent vs. buy gap in Austin and across Texas
✅ Who should buy a home right now (and who should not)
✅ Why “time in the market beats timing the market” every single time

Whether you’re a first‑time homebuyer, a real estate investor, or just curious about the Texas housing market, this video gives you the real numbers, real stories, and real advice.
